findings.source_quote: Will the losing party resort to protests and rioting?
findings.suggested_fix: Consider translating "rioting" with a word that better captures violent civil unrest in Italian, e.g. "sommossa" or "disordini" rather than "saccheggi", which specifically means looting. Example: "Il partito sconfitto ricorrerà a proteste e disordini?"
